categories.name: Chat assistants
categories.blurb: The big general-purpose AIs you talk to. Most are free to start.

items.name: Claude
items.what: Strong at writing, reasoning and long documents. The one Capp would pick.

items.name: ChatGPT
items.what: The most widely used chat assistant, with image generation and voice built in.

items.name: Gemini
items.what: Google's assistant, tied into Search, Gmail, Docs and YouTube.

items.name: Grok
items.what: xAI's assistant, with live access to posts on X.
items.good: what people are saying right now

items.name: DeepSeek
items.what: Open-weight models that are cheap to run, popular with developers.

items.name: Perplexity
items.what: An AI search engine that answers with sources you can click.

categories.name: Coding with AI
categories.blurb: Tools that write, edit and run code with you.

items.name: Claude Code
items.what: An AI coding agent that works in your terminal, desktop app or IDE and edits real projects. Every Drip video is built with it.

items.name: Cursor
items.what: A code editor with AI built into every step.

items.name: Codex
items.what: OpenAI's coding agent, in the terminal, IDE and cloud.

items.name: GitHub Copilot
items.what: AI suggestions and an agent inside the editors and GitHub itself.

categories.name: Claude Code skills and plugins
categories.blurb: Free add-ons that change how Claude Code works. A plugin installs with /plugin install; a skill is a folder of instructions Claude reads when it's relevant.

items.name: Superpowers
items.what: Asks what you're building, writes a plan, then works through it with tests at every step.
items.good: bigger builds that need a plan

items.name: Context7
items.what: Gives Claude current, version-specific docs so it uses functions that still exist.

items.name: Graphify
items.what: Turns a codebase into a knowledge graph Claude looks things up in, instead of rereading files.
items.install:
uv tool install graphifyy
graphify claude install

items.name: Ponytail
items.what: Makes Claude work like a lazy senior dev: reuse, use the platform, write the minimum. On the author's benchmark, 54% less code and 22% fewer tokens.

items.name: Frontend Design
items.what: Anthropic's official plugin for distinctive, non-generic web design.

categories.name: AI models for your own apps
categories.blurb: For when you want AI inside something you're building, not a chat window.

items.name: Claude API
items.what: Claude's models for your own software, plus tools for agents.

items.name: OpenAI API
items.what: GPT models, image and voice models through one API.

items.name: Jev
items.what: Doesn't write back. You declare the allowed answers; it returns them with probabilities. Priced on what it reads.
items.good: sorting, routing, yes/no decisions at scale

items.name: OpenRouter
items.what: One API key for hundreds of models from different labs.

categories.name: Voice and audio
categories.blurb: Voiceover, music and turning speech into text.

items.name: ElevenLabs
items.what: Realistic AI voices, voice design, dubbing and sound effects. Drip's and Capp's voices are made here.

items.name: whisper.cpp
items.what: OpenAI's Whisper speech-to-text, running locally and fast on your own computer. Free.

items.name: Suno
items.what: Makes full songs, vocals included, from a text prompt.

categories.name: Image generation
categories.blurb: Pictures from a prompt, or edits to pictures you already have.

items.name: Nano Banana
items.what: Gemini's image model, very good at keeping a character consistent across edits. We use it through Higgsfield for Drip.

items.name: Midjourney
items.what: Known for striking, artistic images.

items.name: ChatGPT images
items.what: Image generation inside ChatGPT, strong with text in images.

items.name: FLUX
items.what: Detailed image models that follow prompts closely.

items.name: Ideogram
items.what: Image generation with reliable typography.

categories.name: Video generation
categories.blurb: Clips from text or from a still image.

items.name: Higgsfield
items.what: One place for many top image and video models, with presets for camera moves and effects.
items.good: trying many video models in one app

items.name: Veo
items.what: Google's video model, with sound and dialogue generated together.

items.name: Sora
items.what: OpenAI's video model and app.

items.name: Runway
items.what: Video generation plus tools for editing footage you already shot.

items.name: Kling
items.what: Popular for realistic motion from an image.

items.name: Remotion
items.what: Make videos with code (React). Every Drip short is animated this way, which is why every sound lands on a word.

items.name: CapCut
items.what: Fast phone and desktop editor with auto-captions and templates.

items.name: Descript
items.what: Edit video by editing its transcript like a document.

items.name: DaVinci Resolve
items.what: A professional editor and color tool with a generous free version.

categories.name: Design and diagrams
categories.blurb: Thumbnails, slides and explaining things with drawings.

items.name: Excalidraw
items.what: Hand-drawn style whiteboard. Great for explaining how something works.

items.name: Canva
items.what: Templates for posts, thumbnails and slides, with AI tools built in.

items.name: Figma
items.what: The standard tool for designing apps and websites.

categories.name: Posting and growth
categories.blurb: Getting it out there on a schedule.

items.name: Buffer
items.what: Schedule posts across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more from one queue.

items.name: ManyChat
items.what: Auto-DMs people who comment a keyword. Behind most 'comment LINK and I'll send it' posts.
